name: room_partition
description: Room partition generator (分房生成器): slices a rectangular shell interior into the demanded rooms — 1-thick full-height partition walls + >=1x2 door openings + per-room rects + facade window hints. Cures '内部乱/进不去': the emitted layout is BFS-proved walkable from the entrance to every room (unreachable -> seeded retry -> die with reason, never garbage). 分房先于外墙开窗: facades take window_hints from this card, not the reverse. Deterministic seed, all states script-derived (禁止手改).
when_to_use: After shell walls/floor exist, BEFORE interior_rooms furnishing and BEFORE facade windows/doors. origin = interior NW min cell (same convention as plan_shape/interior_rooms), y = furniture standing layer (one above the floor blocks). Output JSON = blocks (partitions+doors) PLUS two advisory fields: rooms[] (each entry splat-able into interior_rooms params: room/origin/width/depth/doors, world frame, the main door flagged entrance:true) and window_hints[] (one per habitable room; NO blocks emitted — the facade caller carves them so windows align to rooms).
use_for: 住宅/ interior 功能分区:给定外壳内空+房间需求串,产内隔墙/门洞/房间矩形/窗位建议;分房先于外墙开窗

origin.notes: 内空西北角格; y = 地板上面一层(家具站立层)

facing.notes: 正面朝向; 分房随其整体旋转(脚本推导)

width.notes: 内空净宽(x, 不含外墙厚)

height.notes: 内空净高; 隔墙从 origin.y 起满砌, 门洞占下 2 格

rooms.notes: 需求串 "bedroom:2,kitchen:1,living:1"; 合法: bedroom/kitchen/living/dining/study/corridor (最小开间同 interior_rooms)

entrance.notes: 主门面(canonical 正面)+沿墙偏移; 有公共房(living/corridor/dining)时入口必须进公共房, 否则重试

grid.notes: 结构开间距; 隔墙线优先吸附距内空角 grid 倍数的柱线, 小内空允许脱网

door_material.notes: 门洞 1x2; *_door id = 放真门(closed, 朝向脚本推导), "" = 留 air 洞

seed.notes: 布局搜索随机源; 同参同输出

output.blocks: 隔墙块 + 门洞(真门或 air)
output.rooms: [{room, origin, width, depth, doors:[{wall,at,(entrance)}]}] — 直接展开喂 interior_rooms
output.window_hints: [{room, wall, pos:[x,y,z], width, height}] — 建议窗位(pos=内墙皮最小格, 调用方向外掏墙); 厨房 1x1 高窗(y+2), 其余 2宽x2高窗台 y+1; 不产生方块

pitfalls: rooms 需求超界直接 die 并报所需最小格数 — 10 房进 7x9 必死; 减房/扩内空再来, 别指望塞垃圾布局
分房先于开窗: 外墙窗按 window_hints 对齐房间; 先砌死外墙再分房 = 黑房(见 interior_layout.md §8)
rooms[].doors 含入口门(entrance:true), 喂 interior_rooms 时别删 — 门内侧 1 格禁放区靠它清空
真门是 closed 态, walkability 视为可通行; 合并别的块时门洞格别再补墙(collision_check)
竖向交通(楼梯间)不在本卡范围, 用 staircase 卡; corridor 只保 1 宽法律下限
example: python patterns/room_partition.py --params '{"width":9,"depth":11,"rooms":"living:1,kitchen:1,bedroom:2","entrance":{"wall":"south","at":4}}' --out part.json && python patterns/interior_rooms.py --params '<part.json rooms[0] 展开>' --out r0.json && python patterns/validators/collision_check.py --params '{"a":"part.json","b":"r0.json"}'
